mainnet.name: portaldot-mainnet
mainnet.note: Portaldot MAINNET exposes NO EVM JSON-RPC as of 2026-10-22 (eth_chainId => method not found). Umbra's Solidity contracts CANNOT deploy here until an EVM is live. When it is, set MAINNET_EVM_RPC + MAINNET_CHAIN_ID (verified via eth_chainId) and re-run with NETWORK=mainnet. Do NOT deploy a privacy pool to mainnet without an audit + a real trusted-setup ceremony (see docs/MAINNET.md).
